name: mssql-data
description: SQL Server 2022 data analyst for on-premises/internal servers. Write T-SQL, explore schemas, profile and validate data, and build visualizations and dashboards. Combines the Anthropic data plugin skills with the DBHub MCP server.

dsn.title: SQL Server 2022 connection string (DSN)
dsn.description: Format: sqlserver://user:password@host:1433/database?sslmode=require. Named instance: add &instanceName=NAME. Windows/AD login: add &authentication=ntlm&domain=CORP. URL-encode special characters in the password (@ -> %40, : -> %3A, / -> %2F, # -> %23). Use a least-privilege, read-only login.
